cur:monumental-san-led-to-calvary.summary: The bearded Christ, haloed and robed in purple, is led forward by a soldier in a blue tunic, while Simon of Cyrene, in red, carries the long cross beside him. In keeping with Early Christian reticence, the cycle passes from this scene directly to the empty tomb, without showing the Crucifixion itself.
facts: On the south wall the thirteen Passion and Resurrection scenes show Christ bearded; the cycle omits both the Flagellation and the Crucifixion.
The scenes were not arranged in biblical order but are thought to follow the Gospel readings of the Lenten liturgy in Theodoric's palace church.
